title: headcount-sync-hiring-prep-scratchpad-maya-2026-02
content:
Purpose: quick scratchpad for weekly headcount sync + interview loop planning. Use this during 1:1s and the Tue headcount meeting. Mostly bullets + action items to capture decisions and follow-ups.

Top priorities this cycle:
- Fill 4 roles (2 backend infra, 1 frontend, 1 ML infra) by end of Q2.
- Push hiring for Platform infra (2 IC3/IC4) to replace contractors.
- Keep interview cycles under 6 weeks where possible.

Current pipeline snapshot (rough):
- Backend infra: 5 active candidates (phone screens passed: 3). Two onsite loops scheduled next week (Mon/Tue).
- Frontend: 2 active (1 stalled due to take-home code delay).
- ML infra: 3 active, 1 strong (final loop scheduled Wed).
- Diversity slate: flag 2 underrepresented candidates across backend and ML pools.

Interview loop notes / adjustments:
- Standard loop: Recruiter screen -> Hiring manager (30m) -> Technical screen (45m) -> Take-home OR system design (if senior) -> Onsite loop (4 interviews: infra design, code exercise, product alignment, behavioral).
- For ML infra role: reduce onsite to 3 interviews (combine infra design + product alignment) to shorten loop. Manager (Sofia) agreed in Slack thread. Link: CONFLUENCE-Headcount-Plan-2026#ml-infra-loop
- Need updated rubric for frontend take-home (Jordan to update template). GH PR referenced above.

Actions to confirm before Tue sync:
- [ ] Hiring manager confirmations for all scheduled onsites (Ethan to confirm by Fri 2/27).
- [ ] Confirm interview panel availability and backup interviewers for site loops (Maya to ping SRE + Platform lead).
- [ ] Ensure offer comp bands for Backend IC3/IC4 are pre-approved by Finance (Finance ticket JIRA-FIN-887).
- [ ] Add two DEI-referral candidates to tracker and ensure sourcer follow-up (Sofia).

Candidate debrief / decision flow (notes):
- Keep debrief within 48 hours of onsite. Use standard debrief doc (Confluence link above).
- If majority recommend and comp approved, target offer within 72 hours of debrief to reduce drop-off.
- For near-miss candidates, prepare clear feedback and consider fast-rehire tags if manager requests another look.

Open questions & risks:
- Risk: Long take-home windows stretching cycles. Proposal: require 72-hour turnaround for take-homes; auto-snooze if candidate misses twice. Need PM buy-in.
- Risk: Candidate lead time from sourcing is low for infra hires (market tight). Mitigation: enable 2 contractor-to-hire discussions and extend referral bonus. Cost impact? Ask Finance for model.
- Question: Should we prioritize ML infra hire over frontend if bandwidth limited? Manager input needed during sync.

Notes for 1:1 with Ethan (hiring lead) — items to cover quickly:
- Pipeline health: 4 hires target, current funnel E2.
- Budget burn: confirm reserved headcount vs open reqs. Any constraints from finance? (JIRA-FIN-887).
- Interview quality: any negative feedback on new rubric? Frontend take-home completion rates low — consider swapping to pair-coding session.
- Scaling interviewers: identify 4 volunteers from SRE to join backend panels.

De-brief action items (post-onsite):
- [ ] Capture scorecards in debrief doc and tag hiring manager + recruiter. (Owner: interviewer who scheduled).
- [ ] If hire: submit offer request + comp approval link JIRA-HIRE-1423 -> HR to draft. (Owner: Ethan).
- [ ] If no-hire: quick feedback email template sent within 3 days (template in Confluence). (Owner: recruiter).

Short-term timeline (next 3 weeks):
- Week of 2/23: finish phone screens, schedule onsites for backend + ML.
- Week of 3/2: onsite loops + debriefs. Goal: extend 1-2 offers by 3/5.
- Week of 3/9: ramp discussions with manager for accepted offers; onboarding checklist update (Alex in People Ops).

Manager prompts (what to ask in sync):
- "Which role is highest-impact to fill first if we can only hire 2 this quarter?"
- "Are we comfortable moving ML infra to a condensed loop?"
- "Any blockers on comp approval or headcount reallocation?"

Reference links / docs to have open during sync:
- CONFLUENCE-Headcount-Plan-2026 (main plan)
- JIRA-HIRE-1423 (backend req)
- JIRA-HIRE-1427 (frontend req)
- GH-PR-frontend-hiring-template (take-home rubric update)
additional_notes: Informal — save decision points from sync into Confluence after meeting. This doc is scratch; do not share externally.
